description: MCP server and Antigravity CLI plugin. Keeps a project's facts (stack, goal, commands) in project.faf, an IANA-registered YAML file, and gives Gemini tools to read, score and validate it and to write GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md from it.
rules: Run /setup in a project before the other tools; it creates or scores project.faf.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md are generated from it.
